exposure: gestational age (moderate to late preterm, term)
outcome: early admissions to NICU for respiratory morbidity
cohort: The study included all infants with gestational age >= 32 weeks admitted to two NICUs in Denmark during 2021 within the first 24 hours of life.
finding: Mild respiratory morbidity is the most frequent cause for early NICU admission in term newborns with short treatment durations, while moderate to late preterm infants also experience generally mild morbidity, though 15% of those admitted developed RDS.
gest_age: >= 32 weeks (moderate to late preterm, term; specifically 32-36 weeks for preterm)
